howItWorks.description: More than just tourist spots — we analyze your personality and design the travel destination experience that fits you best.
howItWorks.step1Desc: 12 questions designed around travel exploration. We precisely analyze your style across four dimensions: E/I, N/S, T/F, J/P.
howItWorks.step2Desc: OpenAI crafts your unique explorer persona — like "Emotional Travel Walker" or "Analytical History Seeker" — tailored just for you.
howItWorks.step3Desc: From 36 travel destinations, we surface the best matches with compatibility scores. Filter by region to narrow it down.

descs.ISTJ: A systematic explorer who digs into historical facts, valuing verified information above all.
descs.ISFJ: A quiet observer who appreciates the subtle details of travel destinations and respects tradition.
descs.INFJ: A reflective explorer who seeks the deeper meaning and human stories embedded in travel destinations.
descs.INTJ: A methodical researcher who analyzes the strategic value and long-term significance of travel destinations.
descs.ISTP: A hands-on explorer who grasps the practical mechanics and structure of destinations firsthand.
descs.ISFP: An artist-soul who subtly feels the aesthetic beauty and momentary atmosphere of destinations.
descs.INFP: A dreamer who creates new interpretations through the emotion and imagination found in travel destinations.
descs.INTP: A scholarly analyst who logically deconstructs the historical context and underlying principles.
descs.ESTP: An action-oriented explorer who swiftly experiences a wide variety of destinations firsthand.
descs.ESFP: A social, spirited visitor who enjoys the vibrant energy of destinations and loves sharing the fun.
descs.ENFP: A free-spirited traveler who discovers new destinations and explores diverse possibilities.
descs.ENTP: An innovator who brings fresh perspectives and creative interpretations to travel destinations.
descs.ESTJ: A pragmatic achiever who systematically tours destinations with an efficiently planned route.
descs.ESFJ: A warm connector who values community and shared experience through travel destinations.
descs.ENFJ: A charismatic storyteller who uses destinations to inspire and move others.
descs.ENTJ: A strategic leader who experiences travel destinations with clear vision and purpose.

INTJ.explorationStyle: Thorough prior research is your superpower — move efficiently through key highlights and deepen your experience with audio guides or expert commentary.
INTJ.recommendationTone: I'll walk you through this destination's historical context and architectural significance, making a clear logical case for why it belongs on your itinerary.

INTP.explorationStyle: Give yourself ample unstructured time to wander and wonder. When a question surfaces, search it out or jot it down — enjoy crafting your own unique interpretation.
INTP.recommendationTone: Facts and logic provide the framework; multiple layers of interpretation await your own exploration of this remarkable space.

ENTJ.explorationStyle: Set clear goals and a defined route, then zero in on the core highlights efficiently. Independent exploration suits you far better than a guided tour.
ENTJ.recommendationTone: Presenting this destination through its influence and contemporary relevance, paired with concrete strategic takeaways for your journey.

ENTP.explorationStyle: Serendipitous finds beat a rigid itinerary any day. Strike up a conversation with fellow visitors — a completely fresh perspective could be just around the corner.
ENTP.recommendationTone: Sparking your curiosity through unconventional angles and hidden stories that make you see this space in a completely new light.

INFJ.explorationStyle: Linger at your own pace and let the space speak to you. Avoid peak-hour crowds and carve out dedicated time for quiet personal reflection.
INFJ.recommendationTone: Centering the emotional resonance and human stories woven into this space — delivering empathy and lasting inspiration.

INFP.explorationStyle: Follow your heart rather than a fixed route. Bring a journal or sketchbook to capture the impressions and feelings that naturally arise as you explore.
INFP.recommendationTone: Conveying the feeling and atmosphere of this destination through evocative, almost poetic language — inviting you to transcend time through imagination.

ENFJ.explorationStyle: Visit with family or friends — guided programs are especially rewarding for you. The joy of sharing what you've discovered with others multiplies the experience.
ENFJ.recommendationTone: Underscoring the social meaning of this destination, with a focus on human connection and shared discovery.

ENFP.explorationStyle: Dip lightly into multiple spaces — and don't miss a chance to chat with locals or join a hands-on program for a richer, more spontaneous experience.
ENFP.recommendationTone: Surfacing exciting possibilities at every turn and building real anticipation for the discoveries still ahead of you.

ISTJ.explorationStyle: Thorough preparation first, then a systematic visit in proper sequence. Read every information panel carefully — the finer details reward your diligent attention.
ISTJ.recommendationTone: Grounded in precise historical facts and detailed information you can rely on completely — everything you need for a perfectly prepared exploration.

ISFJ.explorationStyle: Slow down and let the atmosphere wash over you. Keep your senses open to the small details, and savor the mood of each destination at a gentle, unhurried pace.
ISFJ.recommendationTone: Centered on the traditional values and warm, caring spirit of this destination — a heartfelt, personal recommendation just for you.

ESTJ.explorationStyle: Plan your route and schedule in advance, then absorb the key highlights efficiently. Make the most of the site map, audio guides, and directional signage.
ESTJ.recommendationTone: Practical information and clear reasoning front and center — helping you make the most time-efficient, high-value exploration choice.

ESFJ.explorationStyle: Visit with family or friends, follow a recommended itinerary, and take plenty of photos to preserve the shared memories you'll treasure.
ESFJ.recommendationTone: Recommending experiences you can enjoy and share together, with a focus on warm communal moments and lasting memories.

ISTP.explorationStyle: Touch things, examine the structure, and figure out how it all works. Hands-on programs and immersive content like VR are especially rewarding for your style.
ISTP.recommendationTone: Spotlighting the tactile, experiential elements and structural features that reward a curious, hands-on investigator like you.

ISFP.explorationStyle: Bring your camera or sketchbook. Avoid the busy hours and choose a time when the natural light is at its most beautiful — then let this space's beauty speak to you.
ISFP.recommendationTone: Centered on aesthetic beauty, atmosphere, and the rich sensory experience this destination offers — a recommendation that speaks to your soul.

ESTP.explorationStyle: Cover ground, try different things, and stack up diverse experiences. Outdoor spaces and places with hands-on activities are your perfect exploration match.
ESTP.recommendationTone: Emphasizing direct action and hands-on experience — an energetic itinerary built for someone who truly learns by doing.

ESFP.explorationStyle: Head out with friends and keep an eye out for live performances, festivals, or interactive programs — the livelier the atmosphere, the better your exploration.
ESFP.recommendationTone: High-energy recommendations centered on fun, spontaneity, and memorable experiences you'll want to share with everyone.

quiz.q1: When visiting a travel destination, you tend to...
quiz.q1_a: Explore energetically with others, sharing your reactions
quiz.q1_b: Take your time alone, quietly soaking in the atmosphere
quiz.q2: When reading an information board at a historical site, you focus on...
quiz.q2_a: Specific facts — architectural styles, materials, construction methods
quiz.q2_b: The atmosphere of the era and imagining the lives of people back then
quiz.q3: When appreciating a cultural artifact, you tend to...
quiz.q3_a: Analyze its historical context and significance logically
quiz.q3_b: Feel moved by the stories and emotions of that era first
quiz.q4: When planning a travel trip, you...
quiz.q4_a: Carefully map out your route and the order of visits in advance
quiz.q4_b: Pick a main destination and figure out the rest on the spot
quiz.q5: After a long tour, you want to...
quiz.q5_a: Share what you felt over a meal with your companions
quiz.q5_b: Quietly look through your photos and reflect on the day alone
quiz.q6: At a museum looking at artifacts, you tend to...
quiz.q6_a: Think about the symbolic meaning and historical significance
quiz.q6_b: Focus on the actual appearance — material, size, fine details
quiz.q7: Listening to a destination guide's explanation, you find yourself...
quiz.q7_a: Checking the accuracy of facts and the logical cause-and-effect
quiz.q7_b: Drawn to parts that bring the lives and emotions of that era to life
quiz.q8: If an unplanned new site is added to your itinerary, you...
quiz.q8_a: First check whether it fits comfortably within the overall schedule
quiz.q8_b: Add it without hesitation if it sounds interesting — schedules can flex
quiz.q9: When taking photos at a destination, you tend to...
quiz.q9_a: Take lots of photos together with the people you came with
quiz.q9_b: Quietly capture the scenery and artifacts on your own
quiz.q10: At a destination you're visiting for the first time, you...
quiz.q10_a: First check the map to understand the layout and key areas
quiz.q10_b: Wander wherever your instincts lead you
quiz.q11: After finishing a tour, what stays with you most is...
quiz.q11_a: Knowledge and understanding of why this destination is special
quiz.q11_b: The emotions you felt and the memorable moments in that space
quiz.q12: The most uncomfortable situation during a travel trip is...
quiz.q12_a: Unexpected closures or last-minute schedule changes
quiz.q12_b: A schedule so tight there's no room to breathe
quiz.hint: Choose the option that feels more natural to you
quiz.pageDesc1: 12 questions to discover your travel exploration style.
quiz.pageDesc2: The more honest your answers, the more accurate your recommendations.
quiz.tip: 💡 Tip: For tough questions, go with whatever comes to mind first.
quiz.tip2: Progress is not saved, so try to complete the test in one sitting.
